def basis(logtau, dt, t, past, hold, x, act, log_rows):
    tau = np.exp(logtau)
    h = dt[:, None] / tau
    a = np.exp(-h)
    b = -np.expm1(-h)
    z = np.zeros((len(hold), 2))
    dz = np.zeros_like(z)
    for s in range(len(dt)):
        u = past[:, s, None]
        dz = a[s] * (dz + h[s] * (z - u))
        z = a[s] * z + b[s] * u
    gap = hold[:, None] - z
    k = t[:, None] / tau
    phi = -np.expm1(-k)
    dphi = -k * np.exp(-k)
    flow = np.where(log_rows[:, None], np.log1p(t), t)
    drift = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(hold)), x))
    av = act * hold
    c = np.concatenate((gap[:, None] * phi, drift[:, None] * flow[:, :, None], (av[:, None] * phi[:, 0])[:, :, None], ((act * z[:, 0])[:, None] * flow)[:, :, None]), axis=2)
    r = np.column_stack((gap / tau, drift, av / tau[0], act * z[:, 0]))
    dc = -dz[:, None] * phi + gap[:, None] * dphi
    dr = (-dz - gap) / tau
    ec = np.stack((av[:, None] * dphi[:, 0], (act * dz[:, 0])[:, None] * flow), axis=-1)
    er = np.column_stack((-av / tau[0], act * dz[:, 0]))
    return (c, r, dc, dr, ec, er)

def _basis(logtau, dt, t, past, hold, x, derivative=False):
    tau = np.exp(logtau)
    end = np.cumsum(dt[::-1])[::-1] - dt
    a = end[:, None] / tau
    b = dt[:, None] / tau
    decay = np.exp(-a)
    w = decay * -np.expm1(-b)
    gap = hold[:, None] - past @ w
    u = t[:, None] / tau
    step = -np.expm1(-u)
    curves = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * step, x[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]), axis=2)
    rates = np.column_stack((gap / tau, x))
    if not derivative:
        return (curves, rates)
    dgap = -past @ (a * w - b * np.exp(-a - b))
    dc = dgap[:, None, :] * step - gap[:, None, :] * u * np.exp(-u)
    dr = (dgap - gap) / tau
    return (curves, rates, dc, dr)
